result_assessed: 3-point MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke), hazard ratio, effect of assignment (ITT)

D1_randomisation.why: IVRS, computer-generated block randomisation within site, stratified; groups did not differ at baseline.

witnesses.span: An interactive voice-response system assigned patients on the basis of computer-generated block randomization within each site, with stratification according to history of cardiovascular disease.
The demographic, disease, and clinical characteristics of the patients did not differ significantly between the groups

D2_deviations_assignment.why: Double-blind, matching placebo; Cox analyses in the intention-to-treat population.

witnesses.span: We conducted this pragmatic, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, event-driven trial at 687 sites in 35 countries.
The time-to-event analyses were performed with the use of a Cox proportional-hazards model for primary, secondary, and exploratory outcomes in the intention-to-treat population

D3_missing_outcome_data.why: 96.2% completed; vital status obtained for 98.8%, including searches of health records for those lost or withdrawn.

witnesses.span: A total of 14,187 patients (96.2%) completed the trial, and vital status was obtained for 98.8% of the patients.

D4_outcome_measurement.why: Independent clinical events classification committee unaware of trial-group assignments.

witnesses.span: An independent clinical events classification committee whose members were unaware of the trial-group assignments adjudicated all the components of the primary composite outcome

D5_selection_of_reported_result.why: Design paper (published before unblinding) fixes the primary CV composite and the ITT superiority analysis; SAP amendments (2016/2017, during blinded closeout) changed the event window -- noted for the reviewer.

witnesses.span: The primary efficacy hypothesis of superiority will be assessed by a superiority analysis in the intent-to-treat (ITT) population.

D2_treatment_discontinuation.note: stopped treatment -- recorded for D2 context; NOT missing outcome data
D2_treatment_discontinuation.why: premature discontinuation of the regimen, driven by patient decision, was a major limitation

witnesses.span: A major limitation of our trial was the rate of premature discontinuation of the trial regimen, which was driven primarily by patient decision.

overall.rule: RoB 2 algorithm on the proposals; not computed when any domain lacks evidence
